gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smooth and generous, with sturdy lowercase that never clogs. Early GameBoy stretches its spaced-out capitals above it with a modest swell in the curves, so the heading plays and the text simply carries on.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-orienta: Orienta lets its breathing counters do the talking, and its lowercase sits close in height to the capitals. Over a long passage it would feel quiet and modern, never fussy.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-oxygen: Playful and loud up top, then plain below. Early GameBoy stretches out with sturdy hairlines, and Oxygen follows in a sans whose curves stay open, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-parkinsans: Wide-spaced and cheeky, Early GameBoy takes the top with a faint weight shift along its curves. Parkinsans follows in a plain sans of one stroke thickness, crisp and open, so a long passage would run smoothly.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-pathway-extr: Chunky, spaced-out and a bit cheeky, Early GameBoy sits up top with strokes that shift gently in weight. And Pathway Extreme follows in sans-serif, its rounded letters open and its big x-height tempered by stubby ascenders.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters wide like a pried oyster shell and lifts its x-height high. Make Early GameBoy small and its extended spacing and gentle shoulders lose their swagger.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-pt-sans-capt: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that stay unclosed and inviting, a sturdy workhorse of a sans-serif. Early GameBoy handles the swagger with its brushy, lightly pressured stroke; the body font handles the reading.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-puritan: Early GameBoy brings extended spacing and a mild wire-like taper to the heading. And Puritan follows in sans with rounded forms and oversized counters, friendly and open beneath it.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-questrial: Questrial reads flat and stencil-cut, every stroke the same weight. Its tall lowercase against the mild thick-thin swell of Early GameBoy is the pair's sharpest quality.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads steady, with tall, full lowercase and open curve endings. Early GameBoy's brushy heading can run large while this sans-serif stays modest below it.
